'''Garvan Spasso''' was a criminal trader on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kalab]].

==History==
Garvan Spasso was the partner of [[Borke Valkanhayn]]. But after a piece of trouble, Valkanhayn was forced to flee to [[Glova]] where he continued his business with Spasso. Shortly after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Garvan Spasso hired a group of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] to carry some [[Spice/Legends|spices]] and [[Hologram disc/Legends|holotapes]] to Borke Valkanhayn on Glova.
